name: What should I prepare before contacting AKN Design Group for a deck project?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting AKN Design Group for a deck project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting AKN Design Group for a deck project, it is helpful to consider your vision for the space, including its primary use (e.g., dining, lounging, entertaining), desired size, and any specific features you envision, such as a pergola, outdoor kitchen components, or built-in seating. Gathering inspirational images or creating a simple wish list can be very beneficial. This initial consideration helps us understand your needs and lifestyle during the consultation, allowing us to develop customized solutions that enhance functionality, beauty, and value for your high-end outdoor living space from the outset.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before contacting us, consider your vision for the deck's use, size, and desired features. Inspirational images or a wish list help us understand your needs for customized solutions.
